title: Norway Motorsports Park
specs: Rental kart fleet includes 16 full size karts, 2 cadet karts, and 2 dual-seater karts
Hosts multiple racing series including Route 66 Sprint Series and Margay Ignite Challenge
Minimum age 8 years and able to safely reach kart pedals
All drivers under 18 must have a 2025 minors release on file
All drivers must wear closed-toe shoes
Balaclava (head sock) required; available for $5 if needed
Group party rentals available for birthdays, corporate events, and team-building

blurb: Guests can rent karts for arrive and drive sessions, participate in group party rentals, or compete in championship league racing. The facility offers a rental kart fleet with different kart types for various age groups. Club racing includes multiple classes and series with scheduled races and practice days.
extraNote: All rides must be completed the same day they are purchased
